Frequently asked questions

Is Falchera safe?

Wandroz currently rates Falchera in Turin as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin during the day and an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Turin at night. This is a limited-data assessment: Turin publishes no neighbourhood-level crime dataset and this area has not yet had a full source review, so the rating is indicative and labelled as such rather than presented as evidenced.

Is Falchera safe at night?

At night, Falchera is rated as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Turin. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Falchera a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Falchera's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Turin) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Falchera?

Not yet at neighbourhood level. Unlike London, this city does not currently publish an open, geolocated crime dataset at this level of detail (checked against the relevant local and national open-data portals — see the methodology page for what was checked).
